verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments platform, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports user-configured background automations, and the axis applies. The pack shows no such feature: no scheduled jobs, workflow builder, or autonomous task runner. Spend rules and velocity controls are authorization policies evaluated at transaction time, cards auto-closing when a workflow ends is a narrow lifecycle behavior, and webhooks and the API are developer building blocks; these are adjacent controls or primitives, not the automation capability itself.
